title.rendered: Ian Woodward-Nutt elected as President of Aberdeen Bar Association

content.rendered: Ian Woodward-Nutt, Principal of Colaru Law Chambers Solicitors has been elected as the President of Aberdeen Bar Association. The organisation represents the interests of Civil and Criminal Court lawyers in Aberdeen and the surrounding area and his period of office started on 10th September. Ian stated “It is a great honour to be elected as President of Aberdeen Bar Association. Court lawyers face a time of unprecedented change and significant challenges. I aim to maintain the Bar Association’s positive relationship with the Courts, the Crown and its members in promoting the interests of Court lawyers in Aberdeen and access to justice for all.”
